instruction.name: bcnez
instruction.description: Branch if condition code is non-zero (measured not taken).

throughput.name: 8 not-taken branches
throughput.asm: bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4' --asm 'bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0'
throughput.notes: Not-taken branches saturate at 1.0 CPI. The marginal cost measured against a loop-only baseline (1.007 cycles/iteration, just addi.d + bnez) keeps improving with more static branches because one branch rides the loop branch slot: 0.875 at 8 static branches, 0.937 at 16, 0.969 at 32 and 0.984 at 64, converging to 1.0. The range records the N=64 marginal and the asymptote.

throughput.name: 8 taken branches
throughput.asm: bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 8 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4' --asm 'bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4'
throughput.notes: Taken-branch throughput has two regimes. With a small static footprint (8 static branches, reused in a 1000-iteration loop) the branch retires at 1 CPI: measured 1.001, 1.000 and 1.002 for 2, 4 and 8 static branches. Once the static stream exceeds the BTB, each branch costs 3 cycles: 2.857 at 256 static branches and 3.006-3.007 from 1024 static branches on. The two ends are recorded as the range.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Taken-branch throughput spans 1 CPI (BTB-friendly) to 3 CPI (static stream beyond BTB capacity); not-taken branches run at 1.0 CPI.
